purpose: Define each Editor subsystem as separately addressable by AccessCore instead of treating the entire Editor as one undifferentiated authority.

topics.name: Editor Subarea Access Boundary
topics.purpose: Define each Editor subsystem as separately addressable by AccessCore instead of treating the entire Editor as one undifferentiated authority.

semantics.identity_rule: Each protected editor area/resource has an exact resource identity.
semantics.ui_rule: Visible tab/menu does not grant access.
semantics.composition_rule: Access to parent Editor does not automatically imply all child-resource rights unless explicit policy grants them.
semantics.authority_rule: Editor application access and edited-resource authority remain separate.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: parent path automatically grants all children

references.purpose: Editor subareas are exact AccessCore resources.
